targets.live: https://ourmovingstories.com (old Astro 4 build on Netlify, Sanity staging)
targets.redesign: http://localhost:4321 (Astro 7 on Cloudflare Workers, Sanity production; audited on astro dev with drafts visible)

meta.note: Category 'score' is the redesign as it stands; 'score_live' is the current live site. The redesign score assumes the step-2a Sanity drafts get published (today 10 of its URLs have no published slug).

summary.business_type: Local non-profit, event-based (Our Moving Stories CIC 14473202): free family dance, art and movement sessions at partner venues in Southall/Ealing, booked via Eventbrite
top_findings: Redesign: 0/5 people and 6/13 events have no published slug in Sanity production, so 10 URLs would go to the 404 page after deploy (publish HANDOFF step 2a drafts)
Redesign: unknown URLs 302 to /404 instead of returning 404
Redesign: sitemap lists 3 of 22 URLs (no events, people or /sessions)
Both: no JSON-LD (no Organization, Event or Person markup)
Live: every unknown URL incl. /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml returns an empty 200; 'Astro description' on every page; site not found for its own brand name
quick_wins: Homepage title 'Our Moving Stories: Free Baby & Toddler Dance and Art, Southall' (no '· Our Moving Stories' suffix)
Fill Sanity page.description for home, testimonials, safeguarding; give those text pages an h1
Default og:image (1200x630) and og:locale en_GB in Layout.astro
Link funder/partner logos in the footer and ask for links back
Website link in the Eventbrite organiser profile, event descriptions and Instagram bio

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Redesign: real robots.txt with sitemap line, absolute apex canonicals, lang en-GB, all primary content server-rendered
Redesign: /404 route returns a real 404 status

findings.title: Unknown URLs 302 to /404 (redesign)
findings.description: Astro.redirect('/404') in [...slug].astro, events/[slug].astro, people/[slug].astro; /people and /Events also 302.
findings.recommendation: Astro.response.status = 404; return Astro.rewrite('/404'); verify on the built Worker.

findings.title: Soft 404s, no robots.txt or sitemap (live)
findings.description: Every unknown path, /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml return 200 text/html with an empty body.
findings.recommendation: Resolved by cutover; don't patch Netlify.

findings.title: Sitemap lists 3 of 22 URLs (redesign)
findings.description: sitemap.xml.ts queries only Sanity page docs.
findings.recommendation: Replace with the draft-safe version in findings/technical.md; leave out events with no upcoming dates.

findings.title: No security headers, no HTML caching, preview hosts indexable (redesign)
findings.description: No middleware or _headers; workers.dev and the preview Worker would serve indexable duplicates.
findings.recommendation: Add src/middleware.ts with security headers, preview noindex, trailing-slash 301 and s-maxage caching.

findings.title: www/http redirects and trailing-slash duplicates
findings.description: Live: 2-hop http://www chain. Redesign: /events/ serves 200 with a slash canonical; www not redirected at cutover yet.
findings.recommendation: One Cloudflare redirect rule www -> apex; slash 301 in middleware; trailingSlash 'never'.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Redesign hero and pillar rows say free, families and Ealing clearly
Team bios with real credentials; event pages answer when, where, free and how to book

findings.title: Current-season event pages are thin (redesign)
findings.description: Move and Make 2026/27 is 114 words with empty description; the useful session copy only exists on past 2024/25 pages, two of which are near-duplicates.
findings.recommendation: Fill description, audience, info and 'who leads' for current events; noindex past seasons and link them to the current one.

findings.title: No baby/toddler/Southall wording (both)
findings.description: Copy says movement, little ones, Ealing; age wording inconsistent (under-5s, 0-5, All ages).
findings.recommendation: Rewrite hero/About in Sanity with the words parents search for; one age phrase everywhere.

findings.title: Live site content is broken
findings.description: Dates render 'Invalid DateTime' and '(3362h 0m)'; What's On lists only ended events; broken {{settings.instagram}} link.
findings.recommendation: Resolved by cutover.

findings.title: Trust gaps (redesign)
findings.description: Anonymous testimonials; safeguarding policy cites outdated legislation with no review date.
findings.recommendation: Attributed testimonials; updated policy with review date and named lead.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Redesign: one h1 on home, descriptive per-page titles, canonical + OG tags

findings.title: Homepage title wasted
findings.description: Live 'Home'; redesign 'Home · Our Moving Stories'.
findings.recommendation: Override fullTitle for home: 'Our Moving Stories: Free Baby & Toddler Dance and Art, Southall'.

findings.title: Default or boilerplate meta descriptions
findings.description: Live: 'Astro description' everywhere. Redesign: site default on home/testimonials/safeguarding; 6 events '{name} with Our Moving Stories.'; people 199-273 chars.
findings.recommendation: Fill Sanity page.description and event.summary; copy table in findings/content.md.

findings.title: Missing h1 on text pages (redesign)
findings.description: /testimonials and /safeguarding-policy have no h1 (TextSection always renders h2). Live has five h1s on home.
findings.recommendation: Let TextSection render h1 for the first section of text pages.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Redesign data model (lib/schedule.ts sessions, venues, cancellations) supports full Event markup

findings.title: No JSON-LD on either site
findings.description: No Organization, WebSite, Event, Person or BreadcrumbList.
findings.recommendation: web/src/lib/schema.ts + Layout schema prop: NGO + WebSite sitewide, Event per future session (EventCancelled, free Offer, Place), ProfilePage/Person, BreadcrumbList. Code in findings/schema.md.

findings.title: Venue data gaps block address markup
findings.description: Open Havelock has no address1 and a disputed postcode (Sanity UB2 4RH vs Eventbrite UB2 4RP); Westcott city 'London ' with trailing space; no logo file.
findings.recommendation: Confirm postcode with the venue, fill address1, set city Southall, add a logo file.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Live LCP 1.6 s mobile; redesign hero has fixed height (no hero CLS), Beehiiv iframe fixed height, Sanity images sized with auto=format

findings.title: No HTML caching and serial Sanity queries (redesign)
findings.description: Nothing prerendered or cached; Nav, Footer, Hero and page each await Sanity in sequence (4-6 round trips).
findings.recommendation: Promise.all / module cache, s-maxage + Cloudflare cache rule purged by the sync.

findings.title: Portrait phones get a 5.1 MB hero video (redesign)
findings.description: hero-tall.mp4 1080x1920, bigger than the 720p wide file; Save-Data ignored on the portrait path; both posters may download.
findings.recommendation: Re-cut tall at 540x960 (~1.5-2 MB); honour Save-Data; orientation-specific poster preload.

findings.title: Render-blocking Google Fonts (redesign)
findings.description: 3 families, 8 weights, no fallback metrics.
findings.recommendation: Self-host variable fonts, preload woff2, metric-adjusted fallbacks.

findings.title: Mobile CLS and 7.1 MB homepage (live)
findings.description: CLS 0.151 on / and 0.182 on /testimonials; unresized Sanity originals.
findings.recommendation: Resolved by cutover.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All AI and search crawlers allowed on both; redesign /sessions has labelled server-rendered controls; booking links work

findings.title: Cloudflare email obfuscation and AI crawl settings (cutover)
findings.description: Live email reaches crawlers as '[email protected]'; the same zone setting will probably rewrite the redesign's mailto. Block AI bots / managed robots.txt could change access.
findings.recommendation: Turn off Email Address Obfuscation or use email_off; check AI crawl settings; re-fetch robots.txt after cutover.

findings.title: No citable answer for the core query
findings.description: No passage answers 'free baby and toddler dance classes in Southall'.
findings.recommendation: Plain-language hero/About copy, 'What happens at a session?' block, consistent ages.

findings.title: /sessions shows 2024 dates first without JS
findings.description: Upcoming filter is client-side only.
findings.recommendation: Server-filter upcoming by default; add <time datetime>.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Redesign: complete alt coverage, fixed-size auto=format Sanity requests, lazy loading below the fold

findings.title: Missing og:image on 5 redesign pages; none on live
findings.description: /, /events, /sessions, /testimonials, /safeguarding-policy share without an image.
findings.recommendation: Default 1200x630 og:image in Layout.astro.

findings.title: Live gallery images have no alt and are unresized originals
findings.description: 4 photos up to 2550x3300.
findings.recommendation: Resolved by cutover.

findings.title: No srcset; unused public files (redesign)
findings.description: Single fixed size per image; ~2.5 MB of unreferenced files in web/public/img.
findings.recommendation: srcset/sizes helper; delete unused files.

supplementary_scores.backlinks: not scored: no verifiable referring domains; Common Crawl has the domain unranked

phases.name: Phase 1: Before cutover (blockers)
items: Publish HANDOFF step-2a drafts (people + 6 event slugs), re-run seed
Real 404s via Astro.rewrite
Replace sitemap.xml.ts (exclude events with no upcoming dates)
src/middleware.ts: security headers, preview noindex, trailing-slash 301, HTML s-maxage
Titles, descriptions and h1s (copy table in findings/content.md)
Default og:image + og:locale
Confirm Open Havelock postcode; fix venue address data
Fill current events' description, audience, info, who leads

phases.name: Phase 2: Cutover day
items: PageSpeed + URL spot-check on workers.dev; Visual Editing off in production build
Single www -> apex 301; Always Use HTTPS; SSL Full (strict)
Email obfuscation off; check AI crawl settings and managed robots.txt
Short DNS switch, purge cache
Search Console domain property, submit sitemap, request indexing; Bing import
Keep Netlify 48 h for rollback

phases.name: Phase 3: High-impact improvements
items: JSON-LD (NGO, WebSite, Event, Person, BreadcrumbList)
Analytics (Cloudflare Web Analytics or GA4)
Parallel Sanity queries + HTML edge cache
Hero video tall re-cut and Save-Data handling
Self-hosted fonts
_headers, Instagram placeholder height, srcset, eager first thumbs, local Alpine, delete unused files
Server-filtered /sessions; unique nav labels
Mobile hero CTA, 14px+ text, 44px tap targets, colour Community Fund logo

phases.name: Phase 4: Content & authority
items: Evergreen programme pages (Move and Make, Story Space)
Listings: Happity, Hoop, Ealing FIS, NHS.uk, Peabody, libraries
Links from Eventbrite organiser, Instagram bio, funders, venues; link footer logos
Google Business Profile (service-area, hidden address)
Homepage/About copy for baby/toddler/Southall + 'What happens at a session?'
Three venue pages
Attributed testimonials; updated safeguarding policy

phases.name: Phase 5: Monitoring & iteration
items: Weekly GSC Pages, Events and Sitemaps reports for the first month
Monthly brand and class-query impressions, Eventbrite clicks (UTM), listing referrals
Drift baseline of the new site after launch
